subject: Escalation: OrionTech connector SLA & partner on-call playbook
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@oriontech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@oriontech.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Orion connector - repeated failures during batch sync (urgent)

Hi Jordan,

We hit repeated connector failures during our nightly batch sync for the past two days (12/2 & 12/3). The error is the same across nodes: tokenization mismatch followed by a 503 spike on the Redwood endpoint. This is impacting three downstream jobs and delaying customers.

Can you confirm the support path and SLA for this integration? Our side has already raised a ticket but we need a guaranteed incident response window for escalations.

Attaching the sync logs and a short timeline. Expecting a reply with next steps and an on-call contact.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations | OrionTech
Attachments: orion_sync_log_1203.txt (log/plain), sync-timeline.csv (csv)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@oriontech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Orion connector - repeated failures during batch sync (urgent)

Hi Samira — thanks for the details and the logs. I'm sorry you're seeing this.

High-level:
- We're classifying this as a Sev-2 for the connector (affecting multiple customers/jobs but service still partially available).
- Immediate triage: Ben (CC'd) is joining our infra on-call to look at kernel traces and batching thresholds.
- SLA note: for partner integrations we commit to a 4-hour initial response for Sev-1 and 8-hour for Sev-2 if you have an active integration SLA. We'll accelerate to 2 hours if we detect data-loss risk.

Requesting two confirmations from Orion:
1) Which environment(s) are failing (prod/us-west vs prod/us-east)?
2) Can you share the exact payload size/sequence length distribution for the failing batches?

Marissa — can you take point on creating a short partner playbook (on-call handoff + escalation matrix) and circulate to Orion? I'll coordinate technical triage.

I’ll follow up in 30m with an initial incident summary.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@oriontech.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Orion connector - repeated failures during batch sync (urgent)

Adding what I've found so far (first 20m triage):
- Reproduced tokenization mismatch on a canary request to us-west-2. Looks like mismatch between tokenizer version baked into Orion payloads and our runtime.
- KV cache pressure in the batching service caused a cascade of 503s under peak concurrency.
- Short-term mitigation: decrease max batch window for Orion traffic to reduce cache pressure (can force-rollout in 30m).

Operational ask for playbook: include a hard handoff for on-call (primary + secondary) with phone + pager. We should also include a temporary throttling knob on the partner route that Orion can toggle via the console or an API key parameter.

I'll stand by for a quick call if needed.

— Ben
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@oriontech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood <> Orion: On-call & SLA playbook (v0.1)

Hi Samira / Liam — looping you in with the first-draft playbook for on-call routing and SLA commitments.

Summary (attached: redwood-orion-oncall-playbook.pdf, orion_sla_matrix_v1.xlsx):
- Incident tiers and response windows
  • Sev-1 (data loss / full outage): Redwood initial response 2 hours, target mitigation timeline 6 hours
  • Sev-2 (partial outage / degraded UX): Redwood initial response 8 hours, mitigation target 24 hours
- On-call roster (primary / secondary) for Redwood partner ops:
  • Primary: ben_carter@redwood.com (pager)
  • Secondary: marissa_cole@redwood.com (phone)
- Escalation flow: partner support -> Redwood primary -> Redwood SRE -> Partnership lead (Jordan)
- Temporary controls: API-route throttle + reduced batch window (configurable via support console)

Action items for Orion:
1) Confirm the on-call contacts you prefer to reach (phone/pager).
2) Share the exact payload distribution so we can build a tokenizer compatibility test into CI.
3) Approve the SLA matrix in the attached spreadsheet so we can sign this as an addendum.

If you prefer a live handoff, Jordan / Ben / I are available 2pm PT today for a 30-minute call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-orion-oncall-playbook.pdf (application/pdf), orion_sla_matrix_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@oriontech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@oriontech.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood <> Orion: On-call & SLA playbook (v0.1)

Thanks, Marissa — this looks like a good starting point. A few quick confirmations: 
- We confirm the production environment with failures is prod/us-west-2.
- Orion will assign primary contact: samira.k@oriontech.com (pager: +1-415-555-0199) and secondary: liam.oconnor@oriontech.com.
- We approve the Sev-2 / Sev-1 windows as proposed; please include a one-week temporary exception to the SLA for the initial remediation window so we can both prioritize engineering changes.

Next steps: sign the SLA matrix (I'll route for signature) and schedule the 2pm PT handoff to kick off the temporary throttling change.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Platform Partnerships | OrionTech
